response.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_amount FROM budget), above_average AS (SELECT e.link_to_event, e.average_amount, e.average_amount - o.average_amount AS above_overall FROM event_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.average_amount > o.average_amount) SELECT link_to_event, average_amount, above_overall, average_amount - (SELECT AVG(average_amount) FROM above_average) AS gap_from_above_average_mean FROM above_average ORDER BY gap_from_above_average_mean DESC LIMIT 10;
